controls.name: C_key_matches_committed
controls.must_fire_because: every committed row's key and agreement count must be re-derived here before any tampering, or this spike is adjudicating with a different key function than the pipeline that produced the artifact
controls.can_fail_because: any of the 64 rows disagrees on key or on agreement count
controls.null_must_contain: a key function differing in any field -- status, fuel, hash or result count -- would show up as a mismatched row

controls.name: C_cheat_moves_the_key
controls.must_fire_because: A29: a cheat that leaves the agreement key unchanged tests nothing. Every injected cheat must change the envelope key, and envelopes where it cannot are counted rather than skipped silently
controls.can_fail_because: no cheat was expressible on any envelope, or a tampered envelope keyed identically to its original
controls.null_must_contain: an envelope with no hash to flip, which is counted as inexpressible instead of passing

controls.name: C_agreement_drops
controls.must_fire_because: a lying member must cost the quorum an agreeing seat -- if the majority count did not move, byte compare did not see the lie and "caught" would be a claim about nothing
controls.can_fail_because: the agreement count is unchanged for any injected cheat
controls.null_must_contain: a tampered envelope that still keys with the majority, which is what a cheat on a field outside the key would give

controls.name: C_worktree_key_agrees
controls.must_fire_because: the published numbers come from a byte-pin of the COMMITTED q3.py because the working-tree copy is uncommitted-modified. The working-tree key function must return the same 64 majority keys, or the two are not the same adjudicator and reading the diff was not evidence
controls.can_fail_because: any of the 64 majority keys differs between the pinned and working-tree q3.py
controls.null_must_contain: an in-flight edit that touched key() or its canonicalisation would move these keys

falsifiers.name: F_attribution_needs_a_protocol_change
falsifiers.can_fail_because: any injected cheat cannot be attributed to exactly one worker from what result.json already records
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a corpus where two workers key identically to each other and not to the majority, which would name two defendants for one lie
falsifiers.refutes: the reading that the pipeline cannot name a cheater: if every injected cheat is attributable from the recorded envelopes, the gap is reporting and the fix is a field
falsifiers.fires_when: any injected cheat cannot be attributed to exactly one worker from what result.json already records
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

no_deps_reason: both inputs are BYTE-PINNED into this directory and hashed as artifacts -- q3_head.py (blob of HEAD's q3.py) and result.head.json (blob e1d3bf85) -- because spikes/M1_8_quorum3 has 256 modified files from another lane's in-flight run and a dep-dir staleness check would be judging their work, not this run's inputs. C_worktree_key_agrees measures the working-tree copy rather than assuming the difference is irrelevant.
falsifier: an injected cheat that cannot be attributed to exactly one worker from the envelopes result.json already records, which would make attribution a protocol change rather than a field
